title: TramTracker 2088 — Melbourne Yarra Trams 3D Simulator
description: A complete, production-ready interactive 3D Melbourne tram simulator in vanilla HTML/CSS/ES6, rendered with Three.js r128 and simulated with Cannon.js 0.6.2. It features a 1.35 km twenty-one-stop Hoddle Grid loop from the CBD to the Shrine of Remembrance, manual doors with announcements, a door interlock, minimizable mobile panels, first-person cab and chase views, weather and the Hook Turn Challenge.

build.includes: Initial build, track/cab/doors/announcement/CBD work, stop guides, city ambience, passenger manifests, stop requests, tourist stops, a 1.35 km St Kilda Road/Shrine extension with 21 spaced stops, mobile panel controls and a door interlock.

revisions.change: Fixed a 360° tram spin at track corners by removing duplicate straight/arc control points and stabilising heading sampling with a short chord.
Added a first-person driver's cab view (V) with cockpit overlay, drag-to-look, curve lean, speed-reactive FOV and animated rain wipers.
Added manual opening and closing doors (O / Doors button) with sliding door geometry, opening/closing chimes, a safety interlock and en-AU spoken stop, arrival and door announcements with subtitles.
Extended the track into the CBD as a 518 m loop through Collins Street, Spring/Parliament and RMIT, with new stops, landmarks, roads, City Loop minimap and Hoddle Grid-inspired block layout.
Added stop-guide cards with nearby places and Wikipedia links, richer layered city ambience, real stop names and double-faced stop signage.
Added passenger destination manifests, onboard stop requests with cord animation/cab indication, alighting animations, and five more tourist stops with landmarks, guides and announcements.

Rebuilt the loop as a 1.35 km twenty-one-stop route with a St Kilda Road/Domain extension to the Shrine of Remembrance, respaced every stop to at least 30 m, added the Shrine landmark and two tram bridges, and kept the route clear of buildings.
Added minimizable telemetry and stop-guide panels for mobile, plus a persistent door interlock warning in the HUD and driver cab when traction is requested with the doors open.
